approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the SEO Content Planner

push_brief_to_calendar.notes: A brief becomes a calendar card in the Drafts column only after the user confirms it in chat. One card per brief (idempotency key).

edit_card_outside_drafts.notes: Cards outside Drafts belong to the editorial team. Edits there need an explicit thumbs-up per card.

emergency_stop.notes: Anyone on the team can stop calendar writes and posts immediately. Only the marketing lead can resume.

forbidden.external_publishing: Publishing, scheduling, or posting content to any external surface (CMS, social, newsletter). Not approvable through this agent.
forbidden.cms_social_ad_api_calls: Any call to a CMS, social, newsletter, or ad platform API. Not approvable through this agent.
forbidden.invented_data: Keyword data, traffic numbers, or competitor coverage not returned by a source. Not approvable by anyone.
